title: Broadsheet for Godot 4 is live: letters, notices and coins drawn from your game data
html:
Broadsheet is live for Godot 4. Hand it a name, a sum, a few lines of text or a portrait and it draws the document your players read: a sealed letter in one of twelve hands, a wanted poster with your character printed as a woodcut, a coin with your king struck in gold. 48 presets: 16 letters, 16 notices, 16 coins. No font file and no painted document ships; every stroke is drawn at runtime.

What it does

  • Letters are written with a broad nib along authored letter skeletons, on generated paper that ages, foxes, stains and folds, and are sealed in wax. A ledger sums its own amount column; a cipher slip shifts your text and groups it by five.
  • Notices are set in eight type faces with your portrait printed through a shader as a woodcut, engraving, halftone, stipple, stencil, linocut, riso or sepia print, and held up by nails, tacks, tape and rubber stamps.
  • Coins are height buffers lit as gold, silver, copper, bronze, brass, electrum, iron, pewter or jade, struck with a device or with your own texture as the bust, in round, hammered, lump, octagonal, scalloped, square and clipped shapes, as pairs, stacks, strings and medals.
  • Any field you leave out falls back to the preset's sample; any style key laid over a preset makes it yours. A document bakes once when you change it and then costs one textured quad a frame.

Tested

  • Every preset photographed under Forward+ and Compatibility: 96 frames, zero engine errors, all 48 distinct.
  • The shipped zip installed into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project under both renderers: a letter made in code, a preset scene, a buyer's own portrait printed on a poster and struck on a coin, determinism, variation, age, style overrides, PNG export.
  • 7 attacks, including a path with spaces and non Latin characters, every preset on screen at once, a third renderer, bad inputs and a renamed addon folder; 99 Readme claims checked against the shipped files.
  • Looking at the pictures found what no counter could: small printed letters losing their crossbars when a poster is shown turned, a coin ignoring the value you hand it, reeded rims bristling past the edge of an octagonal coin, and a heading running under a wax seal. All four were fixed in the addon before release.

Free lite

The page carries a free MIT lite: four letters, four notices and four coins, with the same three Controls and the demo.

Where this line stands: 19 Godot packs live from this studio, 1 purchase so far (read from the store the day this went live).

Disclosure: the scripts, shaders, sample letters and notices and the demo were written with AI; the seven demo portraits and the cover illustration were made by AI image models.
